    Questions

    Before you sign up

    Is this live scores or a morning digest?

    Both. The hub updates as games go final during the day, and the 6 a.m. digest + 11:30 p.m. nightcap make sure you never actually have to watch it happen live to stay caught up.

    Do you cover my team?

    If they play in the NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, major college football or basketball, MLS, the Premier League, the WNBA, or headline UFC / boxing cards — yes. Pick them in the builder above and they lead your digest.

    Is there betting content?

    No. No picks, no odds pushes, no parlays. Scores, standings, injuries, and schedules — that's the whole product.

    How do I cancel?

    Reply to any digest email and say cancel. Pro stops at the end of the current billing period and you keep the Free Preview.

    When does my subscription start?

    Sign-ups are taken by email right now. You'll get a confirmation reply with your plan and start date before anything is charged — your first digest arrives the next morning at 6 a.m. ET.
